systemPrompt.description: Prompt for the agent to answer the query.

forceSolutionPrompt.description: The prompt used to force a solution if the agent reaches {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Config#maxSteps} or {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Config#maxSeconds}.

maxPreviousSteps.description: The maximum number of conversationsteps that we want to keep track of.

includeGeneratedImages.description:
If set to True, the images generated by the agent or as an output of its tools will be passed back to
the LLM as part of the conversation history.
